p4_b0.ocr: In the context of evolving cross-border trade dynamics in North America, this analysis provides insights into key trade lanes and their performance metrics for the fiscal year 2024. p4_b1.ocr: Notably, the "AnnualTotal" for the trade lane from Canada to the USA was $160, demonstrating a stable flow of shipments and reinforcing the strong economic ties between these nations.
